headline: Richer mix continues to cushion; MENA recovery key

highlights: The wire rope business benefited from a richer product mix, with domestic volumes growing 14% YoY and better value growth in the US and Europe, partly offsetting the sharp weakness in the Middle East, where geopolitical disruptions and elevated freight costs delayed order execution and weighed on general-purpose (GP) ropes.

The wires business remained a key volume growth driver, with volumes up 25% YoY, while conventional LRPC continued to drag on overall volumes amid weak pricing and USM’s strategy to focus on profitable growth.
A higher share of value-added products and disciplined cost management helped USM sustain profitability, with EBITDA/t rising 17% YoY to INR40,388 (-1% QoQ).
Mgmt. remains confident of delivering 15% revenue growth in FY27 with sustaining operating EBITDA margins of ~20%, while volume growth is expected to improve in H2.
